integrity: The universal proof is self-contained except for the standard stability/2-rank correspondence and Los theorem; exact finite verifier is supplemental, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite proper one-orientation cyclic windows only; deterministic realizable Littlestone dimension, not randomized dimension. Ultraproduct result only concerns the window-incidence formula. Historical priority under alternate terminology remains uncertain.
title: Exact Shelah 2-rank and stability threshold for fixed-width cyclic windows
